output.text: The library book club meets every Thursday evening in the reading room near the east entrance. Assume that Milo is the club secretary. Otto usually arrives a few minutes before everyone else, carrying a stack of paperbacks under one arm. Kira tends to walk in right behind him, chatting about whatever novel she finished that week. Jude, who is the tallest member of the group, often shows up last, slightly out of breath from cycling across town. Noor booked the hall for this term after checking the community calendar for open evening slots. Milo is a few years younger than Jude but has read far more of the assigned titles than anyone else. Otto is in the same class as Kira, and the two of them often sit together near the window during discussions. Noor ranks the current book higher than the last one they read, saying the pacing felt much stronger. Kira is not in the same class as Jude, though they still get along well outside of club meetings. Jude keeps a small notebook where he jots down quotes he likes from each chapter. Otto is not in the same class as Jude, and the three of them rarely study together outside of the club. Milo is shorter than Otto but taller than Kira, something the group has joked about more than once. Noor arrived earliest today, wanting to make sure the chairs were arranged before anyone else came in. The club plans to choose next months book by a simple vote at the end of the meeting.
